cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The team trip is two hundred short. Your prize is two hundred. Do I record it as your winnings or the team's travel fund?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can take the cheaper coach and I can keep some.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That saves forty. You'll still need to choose what happens to the remaining hundred and sixty; please don't record a saving as a payment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone could put in ten pounds. There are sixteen of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then list those payments beside 'prize retained'. You can put in the hundred and sixty, or ask everyone for ten. Which am I telling the team?

reason: Keep the revised one-sixty shortfall throughout and state the sixteen-person count; remove an unprompted correction of free.
